jobgether-jobgether:lever:1d0d2375-00c7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Procurement Category Management Manager based in the United States. This remote leadership role offers the opportunity to shape sourcing strategies across a diverse, high-value procurement portfolio. You will oversee approximately $180 million in spend, influencing supplier strategy, commercial outcomes, innovation, and risk management. The position combines strategic procurement leadership with hands-on category management and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with manufacturing, commercial, finance, technology, and R&D stakeholders to deliver sustainable business value. The role also provides an opportunity to advance responsible sourcing, digital procurement, automation, and AI-enabled processes. Success requires strong business judgment, analytical thinking, influence, and the ability to navigate complexity in a fast-changing environment. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced procurement professional seeking broad scope, autonomy, and meaningful professional growth. Develop and execute long-term category sourcing strategies that optimize supplier selection, pricing, commercial agreements, sourcing flexibility, and supply continuity while reducing financial and operational risk. Manage a diverse procurement portfolio representing approximately $180 million in spend, identifying opportunities for value creation, cost optimization, innovation, and sustainable growth. Build and manage a continuous-improvement pipeline designed to deliver year-over-year productivity and savings, working closely with Finance to track and validate results. Lead supplier performance management, including regular business reviews, performance assessments, and improvement plans in collaboration with relevant functional stakeholders. Develop sustainable sourcing initiatives, including greenhouse-gas reduction, improved upstream traceability, and other responsible procurement practices. Partner with internal teams and suppliers to support new product, ingredient, technology, and innovation launches. Leverage supplier relationships to identify and secure innovative materials, ingredients, technologies, and commercial solutions. Support tail-spend and procurement transformation initiatives using digital, automated, and AI-enabled platforms. Manage budgets and monthly price forecasting through cost modeling, market intelligence, procurement tools, and financial analysis. Lead cross-functional teams in resolving complex procurement and supply challenges while driving alignment across a matrixed organization. Identify opportunities to improve processes, challenge existing ways of working, and act as a catalyst for transformation and continuous improvement. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered. An MBA is desirable but not required. 7+ years of experience in procurement, category management, strategic sourcing, or a related function. Strong strategic mindset, business acumen, and agility, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments. Familiarity with AI-based procurement platforms, digital tools, and technology-enabled process improvement. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab4c4852-0204-.title: Product Owner
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab4c4852-0204-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner based in Israel. This is a fully remote Product Owner role focused on connecting client needs, business objectives, and technical execution. You will own the product lifecycle from discovery and roadmap definition through continuous iteration and improvement. A major part of the role involves building trusted client relationships from initial conversations through long-term partnerships. You’ll translate business requirements into clear product direction while collaborating closely with developers and AI-assisted tools. The position combines product strategy, stakeholder management, consultative communication, and account growth. You’ll work within a highly distributed international environment alongside professionals across multiple countries and time zones. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership while enjoying significant flexibility over where and how you work. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end, including discovery, product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritization, delivery, and iteration based on client, user, and market feedback. Lead client interactions from initial discussions and onboarding through ongoing account management, building relationships that support long-term partnerships. Translate client needs, business objectives, and user feedback into clear product requirements and actionable priorities for development teams. Collaborate with engineers and AI-assisted tools to define solutions, clarify requirements, and support effective product delivery. Build prototypes and contribute to product strategy, helping stakeholders visualize solutions and align around product direction. Communicate product value in a consultative manner by educating and advising clients rather than relying on a transactional sales approach. Proactively engage existing accounts to identify issues early, manage expectations, gather feedback, and uncover opportunities for renewal and expansion. Develop strong, trusted relationships that contribute to retention, account growth, and referrals. Collect, evaluate, and prioritize feedback from clients, users, internal stakeholders, and market signals to continuously improve the product roadmap. Bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring product priorities and business objectives remain aligned throughout the development process. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with demonstrated experience defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, prioritizing features, and working with development teams. Proven experience in a client-facing role involving business development, sales, account management, or consultative relationship building. Demonstrated ability to retain and grow customer accounts over time, rather than focusing solely on new business acquisition. Strong client relationship-building skills and a consultative, customer-first approach. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Native or near-native proficiency in spoken and written English. Experience building prototypes and translating early-stage ideas into actionable product strategies and requirements. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and incorporating emerging technologies into product development workflows. Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully distributed, international team across multiple time zones. Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance competing priorities. A proactive, relationship-oriented mindset with a strong focus on long-term customer success.
